'''Belandi Feearr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Force healing/Legends|Force healer]] who traveled to [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]] to hone her [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]] and save [[Hethan Romund]].

==Biography==
Belandi Feearr had formerly acted as a healer of her community due to her Force abilities. However, after she chose to let a ruthless [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] die rather than heal him, she was charged with murder. She was smuggled away by her friend [[Hethan Romund]] before she could be prosecuted.

After Romund was captured by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark sider]] [[Malefax]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Feearr joined with other friends of Romund to rescue her.
